title: Test socket file cleanup not guaranteed on panic or timeout
description:
Integration tests (integration.rs) manually remove socket files at lines 26, 69, 92, 145, 175, 209 using std::fs::remove_file. If a test panics or times out before reaching the cleanup line, the socket file remains in /tmp.

RISK: Stale socket files can accumulate across test runs, causing:
  - Port/socket collision (though unlikely at high pid)
  - Test flakiness if a stale socket is rebound
  - Debugging confusion for maintainers

ISSUE: No guard pattern (RAII cleanup) protects against panics.

SUGGESTION: Wrap socket path in a Drop guard, or use a scoped fixture that guarantees cleanup. This is a maintainability issue for long test suite lifespans.
